admissibility.rule: A route is admissible only when every construction transition is represented by an exact reaction record and each inter-record material transfer is supported by the native ORD reaction_id cross-reference chain.

costFunctions.definition: Number of reaction-record transitions in the declared route.
Number of distinct intermediate material states explicitly represented between start and target.

scope: A four-route Onto2D analysis space around the pinned three-record islatravir cascade.
nonClaim: Candidate shortcuts are analytical counterfactuals, not claims of chemical feasibility. Historical Load is not an ORD metric, a yield score, a safety score, or a universal property of islatravir synthesis.
